palette.primary_role: Header/nav bg, trust color, brand authority. Navy (#003B95 Booking) → deep midnight (#1A2B49 GYG) → near-black (#1C1C1C Marriott). Coral (#FF385C Airbnb) is the outlier warm primary.
palette.accent_role: CTA buttons (Booking yellow #FFB700, Airbnb coral #FF385C), coral accents (Marriott #FF8D6B), brand red (GYG #F53), decorative (GYG green #A1D55D, yellow #FFD938, blue #81BEFF)
palette.surface_role: Cards (white #FFFFFF), body bg (Marriott warm grey #F4F4F4, Airbnb grey100 #F7F7F7), secondary surfaces (GYG #EBEEF1), highlight (GYG light blue #E1F0FF), success (GYG #D1F6E2), warning (GYG #FFECC1)
palette.neutral_role: Body text (#1A1A1A Booking, #222222 Airbnb, #1C1C1C Marriott/GYG), secondary labels (#63687A GYG, #707070 Marriott), tertiary (#858995 GYG), bobo grey (#B0B0B0 Airbnb), borders (#DCDFE4 GYG, #C4C4C4 Marriott)
palette.border_role: Card borders, input borders, separators. GYG uses #DCDFE4 (primary) + #EBEEF1 (secondary). Airbnb uses #EBEBEB. Marriott uses #C4C4C4 for horizontal rules.

typography.heading_weight_alt_note: GetYourGuide uses 400 weight for H1 (48px) — elegant, modern approach

h2.note: Airbnb section labels 14px, Booking 24px, GYG 36px, Marriott promo 40px

typography.custom_fonts_note: Airbnb Cereal VF, GT Eesti, and Swiss-721 are proprietary fonts not available on Google Fonts. Closest free alternatives: Airbnb Cereal → Nunito Sans or Circular; GT Eesti → Noto Sans or Inter; Swiss-721 → Helvetica Neue or system-ui.

button_styles.bg: varies by brand: #FFB700 (Booking yellow), #FF385C (Airbnb coral), #1C1C1C (Marriott dark), #0071EB (GYG blue)
button_styles.color: dark text on yellow, white on dark/blue/coral
button_styles.text: action-oriented: Search, Book Now, Find Hotels, Explore, Check Availability, Reserve
Learn More, View Details, See All, Sign In or Join
Category/topic filters: City Breaks, Art & Culture, History, Luxury, etc.
Save/wishlist toggle (icon-only, top-right of destination/property cards)

elevation.approach: Gentle elevation suggesting airiness and lightness. Cards float slightly above background. Airbnb uses frosted glass (backdrop-filter blur), Booking uses subtle grey shadow.

backdrop_effects.airbnb: blur(24px) saturate(1.6) — frosted glass for nav/overlays
backdrop_effects.getyourguide: #191B20 at 20%/50%/80% opacity — dark image overlays for text readability

header_styles.airbnb: Transparent over full-bleed hero photo, white icons, solid white on scroll
header_styles.booking: Navy #003B95 solid banner with search form overlay, white text/icons
header_styles.marriott: Transparent over hero (rgba(28,28,28,0.65) scrim), white text, pill Sign In button
header_styles.getyourguide: Transparent over hero image, dark overlay gradient, white text/icons

typical_order: header (transparent over hero → solid on scroll, logo left, nav center or right, user menu right)
hero (full-width destination photo or video + headline + search bar widget + CTA — prominent, above fold)
search (inline form: destination input, date picker, guests selector, 'Search'/'Find' button)
filter_pills (horizontal scrollable pill buttons: destination types, themes, regions — Booking/GYG pattern)
destinations (grid of destination cards: photo + name + property count + starting price, 3-4 columns)
experiences_activities (activity cards: photo + title + rating + review count + price + heart icon — GYG/Airbnb)
packages_deals (featured deals: photo + title + duration + original price + discounted price + CTA)
trust_signals (row of icons: free cancellation, best price guarantee, verified reviews, 24/7 support)
reviews (testimonial cards with traveler photos, star ratings, verified badge, quote — carousel or grid)
booking_cta (centered, scenic background, 'Ready for your next adventure?' + Search/Book button + trust badges)
footer (5-column: destinations, company, support, partners, social + language selector + copyright)
hero_variants: destination_photo (Airbnb style — full-bleed beautiful location photo, search bar overlay, warm overlay)
navy_banner (Booking.com style — solid navy #003B95 banner, white text, prominent search form embedded)
video_background (resort style — drone footage of property, slow pan, minimal text, luxury feel)
dark_overlay (GYG style — hero photo with 50-80% dark overlay gradient, large headline + ultra-pill search CTA)
grid_hero (Booking.com alternative — grid of 4-6 destination thumbnails with overlay CTA per tile)
seasonal_promo (ski/beach seasonal — strong seasonal imagery, countdown or 'Book early' messaging)
marriott_elegant (translucent white gradient overlay, dark text, refined serif/swiss typography, aspirional headline)
feature_card_variants: destination_card (large photo + location name + distance + dates available, Airbnb-style 20px rounded)
property_card (photo + name + rating stars + review count + price/night + heart icon, Booking 8px radius)
deal_card (photo + destination + 'Was $X / Now $Y' + per-night price + rating badge + heart icon)
activity_card (photo + title + duration + rating (# reviews) + lowest price badge + heart — GYG pattern)
review_card (guest photo + name + date + star rating + 'Trip type' tag + quote excerpt)
amenity_icon (pool/wifi/spa/gym icon + label, small card, used in property detail sections)
hotel_brand_card (Marriott: brand logo + hotel count + brief description, 14px radius)

tone_profile.headline_style: evocative and aspirational, 3-8 words. Varies by brand: Airbnb minimalist ('Airbnb homepage'), Booking action-oriented ('Find your next stay'), Marriott aspirational ('Where can we take you?'), GYG experiential ('走遍世界，精彩尽享' / 'Explore the world, enjoy it all')
tone_profile.cta_style: action verbs evoking discovery: Explore, Discover, Book, Reserve, Plan Your Trip, Find Hotels, Search, Check In
trust_signals: verified guest reviews with star ratings
review counts (3,000+, 300M+ scale varies by brand)
best price guarantee / lowest price badge
pay at property / no prepayment needed (Booking)
traveler's choice award / guest favourite badge
anti_patterns: absence of trust signals below the fold

color_mood: ocean_navy (Booking.com: #003B95 navy, #FFFFFF cards, #FFB700 yellow accent, clean trust feel)
tropical_coral (Airbnb: #FF385C coral, #FFFFFF bg, warm greys, rounded everything, inviting informal)
luxury_monochrome (Marriott: #1C1C1C dark, #F4F4F4 warm grey bg, #FF8D6B coral accent, Swiss typography, refined)
midnight_blue (GetYourGuide: #1A2B49 deep navy, #0071EB vibrant blue, #F53 brand red, rich decorative palette, modern adventurous)
luxury_gold (Four Seasons: #1A1A1A bg accents, #D4AF37 gold, #FFFFFF, elegant serif typography)
eco_green (Intrepid Travel: #2D6A4F forest green, #F0F4E8 cream, #E07A5F terracotta accent, earthy)
coastal_fresh (resort style: #E0F2FE light blue, #0891B2 teal, #FEF3C7 sand, white cards, breezy)
typography_mood: playfair_elegant (Playfair Display headings, Lato body — luxury, editorial, high-end resorts)
swiss_refined (Swiss-721 — Marriott: elegant, clean, premium hospitality)
cereal_warm (Airbnb Cereal VF — friendly, round, approachable, modern)

raleway_modern (Raleway headings, Nunito Sans body — clean, modern, booking platforms)
system_trust (System font stack — Booking.com: fast, accessible, trustworthy familiarity)
lora_warm (Lora headings, Source Sans 3 body — approachable, story-driven, boutique hotels)
layout_density: airbnb_spacious (large photos, generous padding, minimal text, photo-first browsing, 20px card radius)
booking_dense (more listings per viewport, filter pills, comparison-oriented layout, 8px card radius, 1140px max-width)
marriott_editorial (magazine-style, large Swiss typography, narrative sections, 14px card radius, warm grey bg)
gyg_modern (hero-first with dark overlay, ultra-pill CTAs, decorative color pops, 8px spacing system)

search_results_page.best_practices: Persistent search bar at top, filters in sidebar or horizontal pills, list/map toggle, sort by price/rating/distance, show result count, price per night prominent

sections: booking_widget (sticky: date picker + participants + price + CTA)
activity_detail_page.best_practices: Sticky booking bar with price + CTA, trust badges near CTA (free cancellation, lowest price), review count visible above fold

airbnb.personality: Warm host, design-conscious friend, aspirational explorer
airbnb.visual_signature: Coral red + rounded everything + full-bleed photography + Cereal typeface
airbnb.differentiator: Most rounded cards (20px), frosted glass effects, 'Guest favourite' badge
airbnb.search_pattern: Where-to input + date + guests in a single row, transparent bg over hero photo

booking.personality: Efficient travel agent, trusted global platform, deals-focused
booking.visual_signature: Navy banner + yellow CTA + system font + sharp 8px cards + pill filters
booking.differentiator: Highest information density, 300M+ reviews signal, 'pay at property' trust
booking.search_pattern: Destination + dates + occupancy in navy banner, yellow 'Search' button

marriott.personality: Refined hotelier, understated luxury, Bonvoy loyalty
marriott.visual_signature: Monochromatic dark palette + Swiss-721 + 52px pill buttons + warm grey bg
marriott.differentiator: Dark inverted inputs, 14px image radius, up to 4.688rem typography, white scrim gradients
marriott.search_pattern: Large 'Where can we take you?' input, Find Hotels pill button

getyourguide.visual_signature: Midnight navy + vibrant blue + ultra-pill 80px search + GT Eesti + decorative color pops
getyourguide.differentiator: H1 at 48px weight 400, comprehensive token system, 8px spacing grid, lowest price badges
getyourguide.search_pattern: Hero overlay with dark gradient, large headline, ultra-pill search button
